# Copilot instructions for Vivek-Kumar

## Project overview

This is a pure static React/Vite portfolio. There is no backend, database, or server logic — all content is bundled at build time from local JSON modules.

- The repo root is the Vite application. `src/App.jsx` switches between public hash views (`home`, `projects`, `about`, `contact`, and `photos`) using `window.location.hash`.
- Project content lives in `src/data/projects.js`; the photo gallery lives in `src/data/photos.js`.
- Profile, socials, and theme defaults live in `src/context/SettingsContext.jsx` and are persisted per-browser in `localStorage` under `portfolio_settings`.
- Theme tokens are applied as CSS variables through `src/config/theme.config.js`.
- The production build is generated by Vite into `dist/`. Deploy the static `dist/` output to Vercel or Netlify (framework auto-detection works out of the box).

## Commands

Run from the repository root:

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Development server (http://localhost:5173)
npm run dev

# Production build into dist/
npm run build

# Lint
npm run lint

# Preview the production build
npm run preview
```

There is no automated test runner or test script configured.

## Configuration and deployment

- Do not commit `node_modules`, generated build output (`dist/`), or `.env` files.
- `vite.config.js` aliases `@` to `./src` and writes the build to `dist/`. No API proxy exists — the app is fully static.
- Deploy to Vercel or Netlify with build command `npm run build`, output directory `dist`, and no environment variables required.

## Frontend conventions

- Use functional React components and hooks. Existing UI code is JSX under `src/components/`.
- Reuse `useSettings` from `src/context/SettingsContext.jsx` for profile, social, and theme data. It merges defaults and applies CSS variables through `src/config/theme.config.js`.
- Use the semantic theme classes and CSS variables defined in `src/index.css` (`bg-theme-*`, `text-theme-*`, `border-theme`, `gradient-primary`, etc.) instead of hard-coding theme colors in new components.
- Project and photo data are imported directly from `src/data/projects.js` and `src/data/photos.js` — never `fetch()` or call a backend.
- Navigation is hash-based and coordinated by `App.jsx`; use its `onNavigate` callbacks rather than introducing a second router.
- Keep animation patterns consistent with the existing Framer Motion usage (`AnimatePresence`, page transitions, motion cards).
- Keep API-free patterns: the contact form opens the visitor's `mailto:` client; media uses static assets under `public/`.
